Recruitment Overview

Gujarat's premier recruitment body, GSSSB, has unveiled a significant hiring initiative for Class III positions, encompassing 6,550 vacancies. The online application portal is open from February 5 to March 2, 2026. Don't miss this chance to embark on a fulfilling career with the Gujarat government. Apply now and take the first step towards a promising future in public service.
